couplingDistanceSummary.interpretation: A transient swap window is evaluated from traces; final state is interpreted as merge if final A/B winding assignments share a common basin rather than a durable exchange.

interpretationDistinctions.cleanRecovery: final target W and high dominant fraction, plus low target distance and field-memory distance consistency
interpretationDistinctions.partialRecovery: target-like W may return, but dominant fraction and/or distance traces remain inconsistent
interpretationDistinctions.phaseSlip: target winding exits to another basin, with validity/minAmp context
interpretationDistinctions.merge: two fields converge to a common basin, not necessarily stable exchange
interpretationDistinctions.transientSwap: A/B winding assignments may temporarily exchange, but final state can still merge
interpretationDistinctions.memoryGuidedRestoration: field-memory and target-distance traces support memory-mediated basin selection
interpretationDistinctions.fieldRewritesMemory: memory moves toward field basin rather than field following memory
interpretationDistinctions.unreliableLineCondition: winding estimates are low-confidence when residuals or invalidLineCount are elevated
